verdict.rationale: Rollbar documents Resolve, an in-product AI agent. It takes a production error and produces a reviewable pull request with a tested fix, and its documentation sits under a root-cause-analysis page. That counts as AI-generated suggestions built from the user's error data inside the product. Evidence is limited to short vendor statements. missing for 10: detailed documentation of AI-generated insights/explanations beyond fix PRs (e.g., summaries, trend or anomaly insights), independent or hands-on corroboration of Resolve's quality.
